description:
Free Windows forensic registry viewer that lets you view the contents of Windows operating system registries.

AccessData Registry Viewer lets you view the contents of Windows operating system registries. Unlike the Windows Registry Editor, which can only display the current computer's registry, Registry Viewer lets you view registry files from any computer. It provides access to a registry's protected storage, which can contain passwords, usernames, and other information not accessible in Windows Registry Editor. The Full Registry view shows all contents of a registry file, the Common Areas view displays the sections most likely to contain significant data, and the Report view prints only the keys you select. Compatible with 64-bit Windows 10, 11, and Server 2016/2019/2022.
